title: 飛行力学Ⅱ
subtitle: Dynamics of Flight II
educationalGoal: The “dynamics of flight” is the foundation of aeronautical engineering. In this course, students will learn what kind of forces act on an aircraft in flight and learn about the balance and dynamics characteristics for stable flight.
advice:
At phase I, students will begin by learning basic mathematical knowledge and axis definitions, and learn about the six-degrees-of-freedom equation of motion.
At phase II, students will learn to analyze qualities of flight after learning linearization of the equation of motion.
In addition to learning design standards, students will deepen their understanding of qualities of flight by learning the basics of flight control.
requiredKnowledge:
Acquisition of Dynamics of Machines
Sufficient skill in mathematics and physics

activityGoals.body: Be able to consider motion mode characteristics by applying equations of motion to actual problems.
Be able to understand the outline of the flight control system.

achievementLevels.ideal:
(1) Understand the equations of motion that describe motion in flight, and be able to explain the mode of motion through actual examples.
(2) Understand the role of flight control systems in aircraft motion and be able to explain its effectiveness concretely.
achievementLevels.standard:
(1) Understand the equations of motion that describe motion in flight, and be able to explain the results while looking at the text.
(2) Understand the role of the flight control system in aircraft motion and be able to explain its necessity.

              The “dynamics of flight” is the foundation of aeronautical engineering. In this course, students will learn what kind of forces act on an aircraft in flight and learn about the balance and dynamics characteristics for stable flight.

              授業の概要および学習上の助言

              At phase I, students will begin by learning basic mathematical knowledge and axis definitions, and learn about the six-degrees-of-freedom equation of motion.
At phase II, students will learn to analyze qualities of flight after learning linearization of the equation of motion.
In addition to learning design standards, students will deepen their understanding of qualities of flight by learning the basics of flight control.
